description: A two-row, three-column TEM composite from the as-cast 0Cr low-density steel strip, mixing bright-field (BF)/dark-field (DF) micrographs with selected-area diffraction patterns (SADPs). Top row, γ-austenite: (a) BF image annotated "γ + κ" with a 500nm scale bar, showing a dark matrix with faint scattered speckle; (b) DF image taken with the (001) reflection (label "(001)" top-right), annotated "κ" with yellow arrows picking out individual nanoparticles dispersed in the austenite, 500nm scale bar. (c) SADP along the [110] zone axis, bottom-left label "[110]γ+κ", with indexed reflections 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002 — the weak 001/002 superlattice spots marking the ordered κ-carbide. Bottom row, δ-ferrite: (d) BF image of an irregularly shaped δ-ferrite island in the austenite matrix, annotated "δ + DO3", 500nm scale bar; (e) DF from the (002̄) superlattice reflection, labelled "(00 2̄)" and "δ+DO3", showing a densely speckled ordered δ-ferrite island against a dark matrix, 500nm scale bar; (f) SADP along [110]δ+DO3 with labelled 002, 002̄, 1̄11 and 1̄10 reflections. The group's argument: κ-carbide precipitates order within γ-austenite, whereas a DO3-ordered phase occupies the δ-ferrite.

observations.observation: All four micrographs in the figure carry a 500nm scale bar; no numeric axis values are printed anywhere (the SADPs show spots and Miller-index labels only).
Panel (a) is a BF image whose matrix is annotated "γ + κ", i.e. γ-austenite containing κ-carbide.
Panel (b) is a DF image formed with the (001) reflection in which κ-carbide nanoparticles appear as bright speckle, highlighted by yellow arrows and the annotation "κ".
Panel (c) is a SADP indexed with 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002 reflections and labelled [110]γ+κ, the 001/002 reflections being the superlattice spots of the ordered κ-carbide.
Panel (d) is a BF image showing an irregularly shaped δ-ferrite region embedded in the austenite matrix, annotated "δ + DO3".
Panel (e) is a DF image from the (002̄) superlattice reflection (top-right label "(00 2̄)"), in which the δ-ferrite island is uniformly speckled, annotated "δ+DO3".
Panel (f) is a SADP from δ-ferrite labelled [110]δ+DO3 with indexed 002, 002̄, 1̄11 and 1̄10 reflections.

The caption identifies (a) as the BF image of γ-austenite, (b) as the DF from (001), (c) as the SADP along [110] zone axis of γ-austenite (hkl: austenite; hkl: κ-carbide), (d) as the BF image of δ-ferrite, (e) as the DF from the (002̄)-type superlattice reflection of the ordered phase, and (f) as the SADP along [110] of δ-ferrite (hkl: ferrite; hkl: DO3).
The citing text states that the measured volume fraction and average size of κ-carbides in the γ-austenite are 3% and 6 nm respectively.
The citing text states that the measured lattice parameter of the κ-carbides and γ-austenite in the as-cast 0Cr steel strip is 0.387 nm and 0.375 nm respectively.
The citing text states that the ordered phase in the δ-ferrite is DO3 with a size of 26 ± 3 nm, deduced from the diffuse superlattice reflections in the δ-ferrite SADP.

The citing text states the ideal stoichiometry of the κ-carbide is (Fe, Mn)AlC with a perovskite crystal structure (subscripts as printed are garbled), Fe/Mn at cube corners, Al at face centres and C at the cube centre.
The citing text argues that absence of swirled-boundary domains in the DF images using (002̄) confirms the precipitate in the ferrite is mainly DO3 rather than coexisting B2 + DO3.
The figure is for the as-cast 0Cr (Cr-free) steel strip, and the citing text uses it as the Cr-free reference against which κ-carbide precipitation decreases with Cr addition.

subfigures.description: BF TEM image of γ-austenite labelled "γ + κ"; dark, slightly mottled matrix with faint scattered speckle; 500nm scale bar at bottom right.
DF TEM image using the (001) reflection (label "(001)" top right); bright speckled nanoparticles annotated "κ" and pointed to by yellow arrows; 500nm scale bar.
SADP along the [110] zone axis of γ-austenite; strong spots plus weak superlattice spots, indexed 1̄10, 1̄11, 001, 002; bottom-left label "[110]γ+κ".
BF TEM image of an irregularly shaped δ-ferrite island inside the γ-austenite matrix, annotated "δ + DO3"; 500nm scale bar.
DF TEM image from the (002̄) superlattice reflection, top-right label "(00 2̄)", annotated "δ+DO3"; a single densely speckled δ-ferrite island on a dark background; 500nm scale bar.
SADP along the [110] zone axis of δ-ferrite with weak diffuse superlattice spots, indexed 002, 002̄, 1̄11, 1̄10; bottom-left label "[110]δ+DO3".

unreadable_items: Caption inline Miller-index tags are garbled in the supplied text: "(hkl: austenite; hkl: -carbide)" and "(hkl: ferrite; hkl: DO3)" — the hkl indices themselves are lost
Caption's γ and κ symbols are dropped in several places ("the -austenite", "-ferrite")
Panel (e) top-right label reads "(002̄)" but the bar placement is only partially legible
No quantitative scale or axis values are printed on any panel; all composition/size values come from the citing text, not the pixels
